data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 迭代改写生成程序，并以预训练和下游微调评分筛选；接受程序继续预训练且可迁移，属持续改进外部工件的方法。

scope_support.feedback_quote: each rewrite is scored by pretraining a randomly-initialized transformer on its data and fine-tuning it on the downstream task.
scope_support.object_quote: an LLM iteratively rewrites the program
scope_support.persistence_quote: PRECOCIAL keeps a single network for the entire search, continuing its pretraining for each accepted program instead of training a new network per candidate
